paper_id: CodeAgent_ Enhancing Code Generation with Tool-Integrated Agent Systems for Real-World Repo-level Coding Challenges
title: CODEAGENT: Enhancing Code Generation with Tool-Integrated Agent Systems for Real-World Repo-level Coding Challenges
motivation: 现有LLM仅擅长独立代码片段生成,无法处理70%以上非独立函数的真实代码仓库
problem_framing: 将代码仓库级别的代码生成形式化为包含文档、上下文依赖和运行时环境的任务
key_insent: 模拟人类编程流程,通过代码符号导航等五类工具让LLM理解仓库结构而非孤立生成
method_signature: LLM Agent + 5编程工具 + 4种Agent策略(ReAct/Rule-based等)
evaluation_criteria: Pass@1 pass rate on CODEAGENTBENCH (101 samples)
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Vicuna-13B等小型模型未见提升,Rule-based策略优于Tool-Planning
evidence_for_taste: mimic this process (gather knowledge, write programs, test)
code symbol navigation tool is particularly pivotal
LLMs still lacking proficient mastery of some complex programming tools
performance on CODEAGENTBENCH is notably poor
thinking_moves: 从人类编程工具使用习惯类比推理LLM应具备的工具能力
代码符号导航工具被调用2.45次,远超其他工具,揭示理解仓库结构的瓶颈
Rule-based顺序工作流优于Tool-Planning自由规划,暗示结构化约束更有效
IDE产品(如Copilot)受限于补全模式,Agent灵活性带来优势
